claim: PCIe1 resource addresses translate through the SoC parent without altering mappings used by existing peripherals.
oracle: Preserve original [0,1GiB) identity range; add only [0x60000000,0x61000000); all PHY/host/config/BAR ranges translate exactly. Reject an unexpected parent baseline before applying.

validation.user_journey: Retry enumeration after a clean failure; no false claim of usable WiFi. Failure leaves rail disabled and serial usable.
validation.code_reasoning: M8 source includes separate HSI1 and HSI2 parent ranges; previous node-only extraction omitted this dependency. Add HSI2 only; no modem0 range, DMA or IOMMU changes. Diagnostic v3 only adds phase/error logs; failure semantics and cleanup unchanged.
validation.unit: Actual parent guard C accepts only expected cell counts/range and rejects changed/extended baselines; resource validator fails old merged DT and passes corrected one.
validation.end_to_end: Exact-kernel build, merged FDT property/translation checks, fresh initramfs reboot, real PCI resource parse and cleanup.

evidence: First trial: OF_BAD_ADDR memory window and missing config reg; host did not bind; supply disabled and host/PHY unloaded
Source comparison: base SoC ranges ends 0x40000000; M8 adds 0x60000000 size0x01000000
R2 runtime parses 0x60000000..0x60feffff correctly; next failure EIO during host init. Supply disabled and modules removed.
limitations: Passing translation does not prove powered link, interrupts or WiFi traffic
exit_gate: Offline checks and clean runtime retry; any other failure remains failed, not accepted.
